dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a pronounced concave spline, originating from a wide base and curving steeply backwards toward the posterior as it ascends to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a small pixel radius, forming the terminal point of the posterior-leaning dorsal structure.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a continuous convex slope of approximately 55 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible horizontal base of the fin is approximately 1.8 times the vertical height measured from the dorsal insertion point.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple superficial white linear striations (rake marks) are visible across the lower lateral flank and the mid-section of the dorsal fin surface.
